description: This source file defines the MidiEventThread class, which extends MidiEventScheduler, manages a dedicated thread to process MIDI events asynchronously, and interacts with a MidiDispatcher to send MIDI data.

classes.name: MidiEventThread
classes.description: A thread-based scheduler for MIDI events, enabling asynchronous event processing and dispatching.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Inner class representing the thread that waits for MIDI events and dispatches them via MidiDispatcher.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the EventThread to process MIDI events asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests the EventThread to stop and waits for its termination.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender associated with this MidiEventThread via the MidiDispatcher.
